name: logo_vectorize
description: Process a supplied logo locally without network or model calls. Use vectorize then audit and show logo.svg with the overlay strip and smoothness report. approve requires explicit rights_confirmed=true, exact params.sha256 and native human approval, even autonomously. Choreograph only that approved vector, then render the local logo-animation template. final_frame, easing and continuity check saved artifacts. Never regenerate the mark with an image model. Inputs and outputs stay in the current job.

op.description: Allowed values: vectorize, audit, approve, choreograph, final_frame, easing, continuity.

input_path.description: Owned job-relative PNG/JPEG for vectorize, logo.svg for audit/approve/choreograph, rendered MP4/PNG for final_frame. Probes use an existing owned reference file.

style.description: One of: reveal, splash, loader, idle-hover.

params.description: Operation-specific strict contract. approve requires sha256 and rights_confirmed; choreograph accepts duration_seconds 1..3, style, personality, idle_loop, background_color; final_frame requires svg_path and exact returned template; probes require observed samples.
